summary: Enhance your skills with our GIS and Remote Sensing Integration Training Course. Learn to analyze spatial data effectively and boost your career prospects.
lede: GIS and remote sensing integration combines Earth observation imagery with spatial data to support mapping and operational decisions. For GIS analysts, environmental planners, and remote sensing technicians, the training develops practical workflows for preparing imagery, classifying land cover, and assessing map accuracy. Participants also practise change detection and spatial analysis to identify locations for action and communicate findings through maps or dashboards.
audienceIntro: GIS and remote sensing integration is suited to professionals who manage spatial information, interpret Earth observation imagery, or translate geospatial evidence into planning and operational decisions.
prerequisites: Prior GIS exposure is helpful but not essential. You should be comfortable working with files, tables, maps, and basic analytical instructions. No programming experience is required for completion. Advanced topics such as Google Earth Engine, automated workflows, and AI-assisted image screening are introduced at operational application level, while core QGIS or ArcGIS Pro exercises use guided datasets. A laptop with suitable GIS software access is recommended.
